Carousel No. 67, November 3rd, 2026

What degraded

  • NOT MERGED. main is red on gridwatch_pagecheck: the large load queue reading has stopped, newest verified month 2026-08. The collector builds ERCOT's Monthly Operational Overview filename with a year ERCOT does not publish. One maintainer edit to report_url in scripts/gridwatch/queue_collect.py clears it, and then PR 457 merges November 1st, 2nd and 3rd together.
  • The deck ships at the round cap at 7.11, 0.89 under the 8.0 top rung, with an artwork median of 6.5 under the 8.5 craft floor.
  • Re-verification confirmed nothing: of 71 URLs, 37 were refused by the crawl boundary and 10 did not answer.
  • SITE=docs node tests/article_edition.mjs can't import playwright as an ES module. The page was opened at phone width by a CommonJS script instead, with 6 images loaded and none broken.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Aurora's driverless trucks at the scale, and the letter's own numbers, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Aurora told its shareholders about weigh stations.

Autonomous trucks have relied on voluntary inspections to bypass them, the October 28th letter says. It says the Aurora Driver can now tell whether a station is open, steer to an available scale lane and adapt to different scale configurations.

The letter puts the production ramp about six weeks behind its prior plan. Third quarter revenue was $3 million against a $257 million operating loss, stock-based compensation included.

Aurora names Dallas to Houston as its own route. Charger Logistics plans to start between Dallas and Laredo under a non-binding MOU, the letter says.

The letter is on the SEC's EDGAR site. Has a Texas scale house weighed a driverless Aurora truck yet?

#AuroraInnovation #Houston #Laredo

The machine changed itself

  • The kit semi_truck holds a close crop: pressed windscreen posts with gaskets, coated side glass, a door with hinges, lock and grab handles, a sleeper baggage door, ribbed steps and a detailed bumper.
    The weekly pass. The judges named the old truck primitive in every round of no. 67, and 'primitive model where a kit model belongs' was named on 6 of 6 decks this week.
  • New kit models checkpoint_gate and weigh_house: a cabinet with a door seam, louvres, a bolted base plate and a caged amber lens, and a scale house with a framed door, a hung canopy and railed steps.
    Built to no. 67's judges' named fix for frames 2 and 3.
  • plan_render_check reads a palette written as one comma separated line of name #HEX pairs.
    Nos. 66 and 67 both wrote that shape, it read as zero tokens, and the plan check's self-test went red on both decks.
  • Escalated: tests/article_edition.mjs should fall back to createRequire for playwright.
    Nos. 60, 62 and 67 each hit ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. tests/ is human lane, so it is written up in UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md.

Every change is logged in ledger/carousel/upgrades.json.

Notes

NOT MERGED. PR 457 is ready and carries November 1st (PR 455) and November 2nd (PR 456). It stays unmerged because main is red on gridwatch_pagecheck: the large load queue reading stopped at 2026-08. The one action that clears it is a maintainer edit to scripts/gridwatch/queue_collect.py's report_url, so it also tries the filename without the year. Once main is green, merging PR 457 lands all three days. The image links in this email point at the run branch claude/daily-2026-11-03. The record. Re-verification read 71 URLs behind 215 claims and confirmed nothing new. 37 were refused by the crawl boundary (utsouthwestern.edu and utep.edu robots.txt did not answer), 10 did not answer, and the rest were dated unconfirmed. Admitted tx-2026-0239, Aurora's third quarter shareholder letter on SEC EDGAR, and tx-2026-0238, San Antonio's data center process on the city's own pages. The deck. Carousel no. 67 covers Aurora's weigh station claims, its November gate entry, a build about six weeks behind plan, $3 million in revenue against a $257 million operating loss, Charger's planned Dallas to Laredo route and the FMCSA cab beacon exemption. Round 1 scored 6.92 with one hard fail, frame 7's headline counting Aurora's routes, which was repaired. Round 2 scored 7.16, and round 3, the cap, scored 7.11. The artwork median is 6.5. All three judges named frames 4, 8, 6 and 3 in every round. After scoring, shipped_check asked for two source-only changes: FIG lines rewritten by fig_inject, and the hook's plus sign drawn by a font rule instead of a span. The frames were re-rendered and the art review was re-bound. That is why the gate table shows the score as STALE. Lead for the next deck on this corridor: c5, Charger's president on autonomous operations already launched along the Laredo corridor, is verified and printed nowhere. Permissions, the final reading. prompt_audit measured 1,962 calls and listed 74 that waited 1 to 20 seconds. Every one was an Agent, SendMessage or Bash latency, which is the queue's open prompt-audit-counts-agent-latency item. The no-stall hook was armed at 05:03:43Z, judged the session unattended from the start (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0 from the host), and refused nothing.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
